My work is advisory: asset allocation, portfolio construction, manager selection and regular investment reviews. I do not set up family office structures or governance. I hold a degree in finance and the CFA charter. I now advise families independently on their portfolios. I am regularly asked to review the reports clients receive from their banks.

services.service_detail: For wealthy families and individuals in Singapore. Services include asset allocation, portfolio reviews, fund manager selection, risk and concentration analysis, consolidated reporting, and regular investment reviews. Familiar with MAS rules for accredited investors. I act only as an adviser and do not hold client assets.

achievements: Advised families with S$4 billion of assets.
Rebuilt a family portfolio that cut volatility by 30%.
Selected 40 fund managers for clients.
Ran 500 portfolio reviews.
how_i_work: I review your current portfolio and goals first, then recommend changes and the reasons for them. We then meet every quarter to review performance against your goals and adjust the portfolio where needed.

title: Corporate Governance Adviser to Listed Boards
about_headline: Adviser to listed company boards on governance frameworks and board effectiveness
about_bio: I have 24 years of experience in corporate governance. I was company secretary and head of governance at a listed conglomerate in Singapore and then an independent director on two listed boards. My work is advisory: governance frameworks, board charters, delegation of authority and board effectiveness reviews, usually for boards going through growth, a listing or a change of control. I hold a degree in law and business. I now advise boards independently. I also sit on the governance committee of a charity.

services.service_detail: For listed and pre-IPO companies in Singapore. Services include governance frameworks, board and committee charters, delegation of authority, board effectiveness reviews, and director training. Familiar with the Code of Corporate Governance and SGX listing rules. Reviews usually take four to eight weeks, including director interviews and a board session to discuss findings.

achievements: Wrote governance frameworks for 20 listed companies.
Ran 35 board effectiveness reviews.
Prepared 8 companies for IPO governance requirements.
Trained 300 directors.
how_i_work: I review your governance documents and interview directors and management, then recommend changes. I present the findings to the board and help put the changes in place.
